passive.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
passive.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

spells.name: Baleful Strike
spells.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing magic damage to the first two enemies hit. If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant stacks instead.

spells.description: Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing magic damage. Every stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by %.

spells.name: Event Horizon
spells.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through for seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.
